storylines: Houston enters year 2 for Head Coach Chris Walters while Caledonia enters its first season under Michael Campbell
The Hilltoppers finished 2025 with a record of 3-9 and the Cavaliers finished 1-9 in Michael Kelly's final season at Caledonia
While this is a scrimmage game, Houston leads official head to head against Caledonia with a record of 16-2.  The last time they met was November 1st 2024
This is CSRN's first broadcast in this format!   This will be a 2 quarter scrimmage.
Coach Campbell was Itawamba's offensive coordinator from 2020 through 2024, this is his first game back as an opponent
The first time these two teams met was October 12, 2001 with Itawamba winning that game 41-0
Caledonia and Itawamba were in the same region before Caledonia advanced to 5A
Itawamba leads the series 10-1 with Caledonia's only win coming in a 23 to 21 point contest in 2023
Both teams enter the game after suffering a week 1 loss.  Caledonia to Itawamba and Amory to Pontotoc
The first time these teams played eachother was September 27th, 1991 and they have played 23 times since.
Amory has won 20 of the matchups and the teams have played each season since 2017.
This is the second time these teams have played eachother - last year Lamar won 55 to 15
Coach Campbell picked up his first win last week as the Cavaliers beat Amory 27-7
Last week, Caledonia's Tyler Long scored 2 rushing touchdowns to go with 148 yards on 22 carriers
Lamar's Stacy Luker enters his first season as the Raiders' head coach after Jacob Land left for Madison Ridgeland Academy.
Coach Luker is a 7 time state champion coach coming over from Alabama.  He has accumulated 260 wins in his career.
Lamar is the reigning MAIS 4A State Champions
